offer.text: I deal in coin for blood, and right now I'm overbooked. Clear 8 zombies off my contract and the pay's yours.

accept.text: Smart. No questions, just results. I like that.

decline.text: More for me, then. Your loss.

in_progress.text: Contract's still open. How many left?

ready.text: Eight bodies, contract closed. You work clean. I respect that.

complete.text: Pleasure doing business. There's always more work for a pro.
